title: Middle-income Americans are feeling the squeeze
summary:

title: The oil market is facing a transportation crisis that suggests energy costs aren't falling soon
summary:
Oil prices have fallen from wartime peaks, but a broader transportation crisis in the crude market suggests it may not matter so far as preventing further pain for consumers.
Energy costs have been top of mind for investors for most of this year as the war has dragged on.
But it's no longer an oil supply shortage energy experts are worried about — it's a shipping crisis that has drawn more attention recently, analysts watching the crude market say.
For consumers, it's fundamentally changed the equation for the cost of supplying oil — meaning energy costs could stay high even if oil prices cooled from their current levels, energy experts say.

title: Expansion of Heathrow Airport would drive growth, chancellor Healey says
summary:
Chancellor John Healey has said building a third runway at Heathrow Airport has "always been a case for growth" after Prime Minister Andy Burnham refused to say if he backed the expansion.
Healey said airport expansion, including at Heathrow, had been "a big part of jobs and growth" in recent decades, speaking at the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in Bangkok.
His comments came after Prime Minister Andy Burnham was more sceptical, telling the BBC last month it was "a matter for London and Londoners".
Healey's predecessor Rachel Reeves had put the airport's expansion at the centrepiece of an argument that Britain was open for business.
Healey told reporters: "The case for a third runway at Heathrow has always been a case for growth."
